description: Grants ONLY extract_dom and capture_and_analyze_chart to remote broker pages loaded inside the pre-created child tab webviews (tab-1..tab-16). The remote origins are locked to the supported broker domains so a logged-in trading page can push its DOM snapshot back to the scanner and hand an on-demand chart capture to the OpenCode analysis pipeline. No other command is reachable from remote content. When a new broker is added to the whitelist, also add its origins here and to the extractor content script.
